about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Shri Thanedar

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ABOLISHING ICE
statements.title: ABOLISHING ICE
sentences: We must abolish ICE. ____________________
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of abolishing ICE.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING FOR DETROIT
statements.title: FIGHTING FOR DETROIT
sentences: His tariffs have hurt Detroit's auto industry.
Detroit needs affordable housing, not Trump's insults.
Mr. Speaker, I am fighting for Detroit, fighting to bring costs down, and make life more affordable for all.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IMPEACHING SECRETARY PETE HEGSETH
statements.title: IMPEACHING SECRETARY PETE HEGSETH
sentences: Mr. Speaker, this week, I introduced articles to impeach Secretary Pete Hegseth for murder and conspiracy to murder and reckless and unlawful mishandling of classified information.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REAL SOLUTIONS FOR MANUFACTURING IN MICHIGAN
statements.title: REAL SOLUTIONS FOR MANUFACTURING IN MICHIGAN
sentences: Mr. Trump promised that tariffs would protect our jobs.
We need real solutions, like job training, stronger unions, and building the future of mobility right here in Detroit. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CENSURING ANTI-IMMIGRANT SENTIMENT
statements.title: CENSURING ANTI-IMMIGRANT SENTIMENT
sentences: I have introduced a censure resolution, H. Res. 553, against Andy Ogles for his horrific anti-immigrant sentiment.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: THE TRUTH STILL MATTERS
statements.title: THE TRUTH STILL MATTERS
sentences: President Donald J. Trump has been committing crimes since day one: bribery, corruption, taking power from Congress, creating an unlawful office in DOGE, violating First Amendment rights, ignoring due process, and, finally, refusing to abide by a unanimous Supreme Court ruling.
His reckless tariffs hurt American families, and he even threatened military actions against our allies. 4.
He gave Elon Musk unconstitutional control over government agencies and American people's personal data. 6.
If we allow this to continue, we are telling the American people that the Presidency is above the law and that the Constitution is optional.
I love America, and I will do anything to protect our Constitution and our democratic values.
That is why I introduced H. Res. 353 to impeach Donald J. Trump, outlining seven Articles of Impeachment because when a President violates the Constitution, Congress must act.
Now we are fighting--in the courts, in Congress, and in the court of public opinion--because the truth still matters.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DOE AND SBA RESEARCH ACT
statements.title: DOE AND SBA RESEARCH ACT

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: U.S. GOVERNMENT SERVES AMERICAN PEOPLE, NOT WEALTHY SHAREHOLDERS
statements.title: U.S. GOVERNMENT SERVES AMERICAN PEOPLE, NOT WEALTHY SHAREHOLDERS
sentences: Thousands will die around the world because USAID won't deliver lifesaving food and medicine.
Millions will lose control of their personal information, such as Social Security numbers, banking information, Social Security checks, and Medicare benefits.
Rest assured, Democrats care, I care, and we will use every tool at our disposal to get rid of this unelected, power-hungry, egocentric billionaire. ____________________
